title: Relationship Between Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing and Ca-P in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
brief_summary: Reductions in exercise capacity associated with exercise intolerance augment cardiovascular disease risk and predict mortality in chronic kidney disease. This study utilized cardiopulmonary exercise testing to (a) investigate mechanisms of exercise intolerance; (b) unmask subclinical ca and p and vitamin D abnormalities that may precede cardiovascular disease in chronic kidney disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* CKD Patients with GFR \<60 non-dialysis
* age\<18

Exclusion Criteria:

* active coronary disease
